messages:
alex kim: Heads-up — AcmeCorp is seeing increased 5xx + request timeouts from their Dedicated pool in us-west-2. CS says SLA eyeing breach if this continues. Logs attached in the ticket: ``ERR: kv cache miss -> slow-path OOM, 1200ms P90``

maria chen: Ack. Seeing the same in the dashboard for their shard. Latency jump started ~09:12UTC after a deployment. Can we confirm if this is runtime or infra?

sanjay patel: I'm looking at pod logs now. A subset of GPUs reported GPU OOMs ~09:10, runtime retried which cascaded to request timeouts. Suspect a model variant change + batching spike.

alex kim: @sanjay can you own hotfix? We need ETA for a patch or safe rollback. Maria pls keep CS updated with a short customer-facing note (workaround).

sanjay patel: I can own. Plan: 1) disable aggressive auto-batching for that customer route 2) revert latest model variant for the pool 3) apply a memory-limit guard in the runtime to fail-fast rather than OOM cascade. Will open PRs. ETA: 3.5-4h for PR+canary if nothing blocks.

maria chen: Great. I'll tell CS to tell AcmeCorp to drop concurrency to 0.5x as temporary mitigation (they can throttle client side). Also offering region failover to eu-central if they want immediate relief.

priya rao: Oncall: if we do the revert, what's the rollback plan if canary increases errors?

sanjay patel: Canary plan: 5% of traffic to reverted image + boxing memory guard. Monitor p50/p90 and 5xx for 30m. If errors increase -> immediate rollback to current image and increase autoscale buffer. Priya, can you and Tom watch the canary window?

tom brooks: Yeah I can monitor. I'll also prepare a quick LB rule to divert traffic out of the affected pool if needed.

ops-bot: deploy: canary start queued by sanjay patel — will run after CI pass. CI status: 1/3 flaky tests, investigating.

alex kim: If CI blocks, we need an emergency patch: change batching config in configstore and roll config only (no image). How long to roll config globally?

sanjay patel: Config-only roll should be ~25m to propagate to nodes. I'll prepare config change in parallel to PR.

maria chen: CS asked for a commitment window to report back. Can we say "initial mitigation within 1 hour (config roll or throttle), full fix within 4 hours"?

priya rao: I can commit to watching and coordinating with oncall during that window. If canary fails, we'll revert and call a pager.

alex kim: OK final commitments: Sanjay -> hotfix + config roll (config first if CI blocks). Tom & Priya -> canary monitoring + LB fallback. Maria -> customer comms and offer region failover. I'll update leadership and legal. Reactions: :thumbsup: if you accept or reply with blockers.

sanjay patel: :thumbsup: accepted. Opening config PR now: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/+/12345

maria chen: :thumbsup: sending CS note now.

tom brooks: :thumbsup: setting up LB alerting and dashboard shortlink: https://dashboards/redwood/p/allocs/AcmeCorp

alex kim: Thanks team — keep this thread updated with PR links, canary results, and any timeline slips. We'll escalate to SRE oncall if we hit >15% error rate after mitigations.

ops-bot: update: config PR merged by sanjay patel — rolling to us-west-2 (progress 12% -> 100%).

maria chen: CS update: told AcmeCorp to throttle to 0.5x and offered eu-central. They accepted throttle for now.

ops-bot: monitoring: us-west-2 5xx rate down from 6.1% -> 0.9% after config roll.

alex kim: Closing loop — looks like mitigation succeeded. Sanjay will continue with image PR and runtime guard for full fix. We'll reopen if any regression. Thanks all. :party:
